            # Meeting 2 starts at time2

            return (time1 + duration1 + travel_time <= time2) or (time2 + duration2 + travel_time <= time1)

                problem.addConstraint(constraint_func, [friend1["name"], friend2["name"]])
    
    # Find a solution
